scope: All twelve public main revisions pinned together at 2026-10-03T06:03:18.523669+00:00, with the vocabulary census, subsets and record statistics regenerated at those pins. The site audit records these pins and the live sources checked during the refresh. Merged-PR totals cover all twelve Mechs, culturebotai-claw and CultureBotAI.github.io. They are all-time GitHub counts queried during the refresh, rather than counts cut off at the pin time; the two supporting repositories are recorded separately from Mech record statistics in mech_stats.json. Card sources are published browsers, CultureMech's generated README inventory and DUFMech's frozen seed-family JSON. DUF seed families remain explicitly distinguished from curated mechanism records. All twelve pinned repositories contain CC BY 4.0 project-data and BSD-3-Clause code licenses, preserving upstream and historical terms. Capability declarations describe contract adoption, not a certification of complete validation coverage or blocking enforcement.
